control_failures.control_label: inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report - kinetic exposure at DZ-9201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GROUND_CONDITION_INSPECTION: the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters on DZ-9201 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in monitoring and inspecting ground conditions, specifically inspecting highwalls and batters. DZ-9201 (earthmoving fleet) is in service for loading and dozing. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 13 December 2012 a hazard report was recorded on DZ-9201 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during commissioning of replacement equipment; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
